## 2. Model Audit & Diagnostic Report

| Model Bundle | Algorithm | Features | Classes | Preprocessing | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `models_portscan_v2` | Random Forest | 76 | `BENIGN`, `PortScan` | `StandardScaler` + `LabelEncoder` | **Active / Verified**. Achieves 100% accuracy on sample test fixtures. |
| `models_multi` | Random Forest | 77 | 8 classes (`BENIGN`, `Bot`, `BruteForce`, `DoS_DDoS`, `Infiltration`, `Other`, `PortScan`, `WebAttack`) | `SimpleImputer` (median) | **Active / Verified**. 99.54% overall accuracy, Macro F1 82.23%. |
| `models` | Random Forest | 76 | `BENIGN`, `PortScan` | Legacy Scaler | Baseline legacy model. |

### Diagnostic Findings:
1. **Pre-processing Discrepancy:** `models_portscan_v2` requires a `StandardScaler` transformation, whereas `models_multi` uses a `SimpleImputer` with 77 features (incorporates `Fwd Header Length.1`). The backend previously only supported `models_portscan_v2`.
2. **Missing Model Switcher:** Frontend and backend lacked dynamic switching between the binary PortScan detector and the 8-class Multiclass detector.
